title: cdp-port-block-foreign-chrome-clear
desc: Fix: CDP port 9612-9615 occupied by foreign Chrome processes -- find and kill the blockers
steps: SYMPTOM: wkappbot cdp open fails with 'CDP port block 9612-9615 fully occupied by foreign processes'.
CAUSE: ports are SHA256-derived per CWD (D:/GitHub/personal-docs -> 9612-9615). Another Chrome instance grabbed them before wkappbot.
findstr '961[2-5]' -> note PIDs. Then tasklist /FI 'PID eq <pid>' to confirm they are chrome.exe.
CHECK tabs on port: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9612/json
python3 -c "import json,sys; [print(t['url'][:80]) for t in json.load(sys.stdin)]"
KILL foreign Chrome: Stop-Process -Id <pid> -Force (safe -- these are NOT wkappbot-owned instances). OR close all Chrome windows manually if unsure.
VERIFY clear: wkappbot cdp open <url> => OK {hwnd:..., cdp:9612}
NOTE: wkappbot-owned Chrome (launched by cdp open) appears in wkappbot a11y windows. Foreign = not in that list. Never kill wkappbot-owned Chrome -- use wkappbot cdp close instead.

requirements.cmd: wkappbot skill search cdp port block
wkappbot skill search chrome foreign port
